designer.note: The OpenAI model name lives only in .env as AGENT5_OPENAI_MODEL. Do not pin it in code. Groq remains an optional fallback.

designed_steps.2: identify scenario categories (library supplies a mandatory floor only)
designed_steps.6: expected results and the pass/fail rule (threshold numbers stay governed)
designed_steps.8: expected evidence model: what must be observed for the metric to be calculable

react.pattern: ReAct within steps, the supporting pattern on the architecture slide
react.note: A rejected design is returned to the model with the validator's reasons attached so it repairs its own work. Code never substitutes a design of its own.

context_aware_selection: deferred - a later change will pick the model from architecture, metric family, and data classification
forbidden: Never use the SUT generator as the test designer. The designer is a separate OpenAI (or Groq) client.
